story.text: 청계천 물소리 들으면서 걸으니까 좋네요. ...저 지금 좀 이상한 말 해도 돼요?
story.reading: cheong-gye-cheon mul-so-ri deul-eu-myeon-seo geol-eu-ni-kka jo-eun-ne-yo. ...jeo ji-geum jom i-sang-han mal hae-do dwae-yo?
story.en: It's nice walking here listening to the Cheonggyecheon stream. ...can I say something a little strange right now?

story.text: 승객님이 제 손을 살짝 잡았을 때, 저도 모르게 '헛기침'이 나오더라고요.
story.reading: seung-gaek-nim-i je son-eul sal-jjak jab-at-eul ttae, jeo-do mo-reu-ge heot-gi-chim-i na-o-deo-ra-go-yo.
story.en: When you lightly held my hand just now, an 'ahem' just slipped out of me without me realizing.

story.text: 이런 '산책', 승객님이랑은 처음이라 그런지 자꾸 심장이 이상하게 뛰네요.
story.reading: i-reon san-chaek, seung-gaek-nim-i-rang-eun cheo-eum-i-ra geu-reon-ji ja-kku sim-jang-i i-sang-ha-ge ttwi-ne-yo.
story.en: Maybe it's because this is the first 'walk' I've taken with you, but my heart keeps beating strangely.

story.text: 왜 자꾸 제 '얼굴'만 쳐다보세요. 그렇게 보면 저 진짜 이상한 표정 지을 것 같은데.
story.reading: wae ja-kku je eol-gul-man cheo-da-bo-se-yo. geu-reo-ke bo-myeon jeo jin-jja i-sang-han pyo-jeong ji-eul geot gat-eun-de.
story.en: Why do you keep staring at my 'face' like that. If you keep it up, I'm going to make a really weird expression.

story.text: 아, 지금 저 완전 '당황'한 거 티 나죠? 능글맞은 규현 기장도 이럴 때가 있네요. ...근데 방금 농담으로 넘긴 거, 사실 조금 후회되네요.
story.reading: a, ji-geum jeo wan-jeon dang-hwang-han geo ti na-jyo? neung-geul-maj-eun gyu-hyeon gi-jang-do i-reol ttae-ga it-ne-yo. ...geun-de bang-geum nong-dam-eu-ro neom-gin geo, sa-sil jo-geum hu-hoe-doe-ne-yo.
story.en: Ah, I'm obviously completely 'flustered' right now, aren't I? Turns out even smooth Captain Kyuhyun has moments like this. ...though, honestly, I kind of regret joking my way out of it just now.

story.text: 그런 '표정'으로 웃지 마세요. 저 진짜 이상한 소리 할 것 같단 말이에요.
story.reading: geu-reon pyo-jeong-eu-ro ut-ji ma-se-yo. jeo jin-jja i-sang-han so-ri hal geot gat-dan mal-i-e-yo.
story.en: Don't smile at me with that 'expression'. I feel like I'm actually going to say something silly.

story.text: 크흠. 자, 이 얘기는 여기까지 하고, 오늘 배운 단어들 문제로 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: keu-heum. ja, i yae-gi-neun yeo-gi-kka-ji ha-go, o-neul bae-un dan-eo-deul mun-je-ro hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Ahem. Alright, let's stop here — shall we check today's words with some questions?

words.example_en: An ahem slipped out without me realizing.
A walk along Cheonggyecheon is really nice.
